description: Niels Basjes publishes Modbus Schema to define structured mappings for reading registers from industrial and energy devices. Its README describes a specification and library, then links companion device schemas and a SunSpec schema generator. Users supply a device-specific register map and Modbus connection; outputs are named, typed values that are easier to integrate than raw register addresses. Geographic coverage is not fixed because the toolkit is an interoperability layer. GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing for this core repository. A limitation is that a schema may be incomplete or wrong for a firmware revision, and this library does not verify meter calibration or provide historical readings by itself. It can prepare telemetry from inverters, meters and controllers for digital-twin or energy-system simulation. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model is a planner, not a field protocol toolkit. No device connection, schema bundle or package was downloaded.
name: Modbus Schema Toolkit
